integrity: The argument relies on the classical transcendence of \(e\). Finite verification is corroborative only; the all-parameter proof is symbolic, and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only Ahn's eventually-consecutive exceptional set \(C\). It proves an explicit inclusion in \(\mathbb Q+\mathbb Q^{\times}e^{-1}\), not equality with that ambient affine set, and does not determine irrationality exponents or algebraic independence.
title: Arithmetic form and transcendence of the exceptional Engel–Pierce set
